text:
sam: quick heads-up 0min, on-boarded ranklite-3b int4-fastquant into bench-suite. initial run shows -2.8% NDCG@5 vs fp16 on bench-seedset-v1. curious if anyone sees low-hanging causes?

li: context: is that full bench or a small holdout? any cohort breakdown?

sam: small holdout (5k queries). biggest drops are for short queries (<40 chars) and when candidate pool has many near-duplicates. NDCG@1 -4.7%, MRR -1.9%.

harper: duplicates can hide rounding noiseif logits for near-equal candidates get quantized differently you'll see top1 flips. did bench dedupe candidates the same way prod does?\

sam: bench uses light-dedupe (score-based threshold), prod uses strong-dedupe (fingerprint). I ran a follow-up with strict dedupe and the gap narrowed to -1.3%.

li: interesting. also check preprocessing parity: bench strips non-alpha chars for some datasets, prod keeps punctuation. short queries could be punctuation-heavy (think symbols/search operators).
sam: i checked tokenizer versions: both tkn-v4, but bench applies lowercasing for this dataset. that might change BPE split for short tokens.

ops-bot: Notice: bench job queued  eval-run/4087654321-baselines (tag=ranklite-3b,fpset=fp16)

ci-bot: CI: eval-run/4087654321-int4-fastquant started (dataset=bench-seedset-v1, preproc=prod-parity, dedupe=strict). ETA ~18m

harper: also worth trying a tiny temperature tweak pre-softmax or per-head scaling. quant can compress logits; small scale changes recover ordering without retraining.

li: calibration matters: what calset used? if it was generic tokens it may not capture punctuation-heavy short queries. try domain-focused calset (searchops) or include augmented queries with punctuation.

sam: calset was generic-10k. re-running with calset=searchops-2k + per-channel-scale and post-scale=1.02 now. command: 

```bash
bench-eval --model ranklite-3b --quant int4-fastquant --calset searchops-2k \
  --dataset bench-seedset-v1 --preproc prod-parity --dedupe strict \
  --quant-scale per-channel --post-rescale 1.02
```

ci-bot: CI: job 4087654321-2 finished  int4-fastquant + searchops calset: NDCG@5 = 0.278 (-0.6% vs fp16), MRR = 0.512 (-0.3%)

li: that's a big win from calibration. still small residual gap. can we capture a handful of failure examples (10) to see if flips are systematic around punctuation/stopwords?
harper: also add a tiny KV-cache disable test and fixed-candidate-order to rule out nondet shuffling effects.

sam: will do. short-term mitigation: route queries <20 tokens to int8 nodes; long-term: add searchops calset to default PTQ flow and extend bench holdout with dedupe parity + short-query slice.

ops-bot: Reminder: open ticket required for infra routing changes.

ci-bot: CI: job 4087654321-3 queued  int4-fastquant + per-channel + no-kvcache + fixed-order (ETA ~20m)

li: can someone draft a 1-paragraph note for the model card: mention int4 caveats (short-query sensitivity, dedupe mismatch), calibration recommendations, and temporary routing rule?
sam: on it  will paste model-card blurb and 10 failure pairs once ci job finishes. thanks!
